title: window.OriginAgentCluster is true, but there is no isolation between main page and iFrame
body:
Chromium bug link: [https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1188567](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1188567)

Good morning,

I'm writing to you because I have an issue when trying to use the new amazing standard of OriginAgentCluster with **chrome version 89.0.4389.90**
[https://github.com/WICG/origin-agent-cluster](https://github.com/WICG/origin-agent-cluster)

I am currently working on **localhost** and in my application I need to isolate some operations made on SVGs in order to gain performances on the main app.

This is the schema of my application:
![iframe_originAgentCluster](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111282904-c9ffa200-863e-11eb-8541-84e7d00d9986.png)

As you can see I have 4 iframes whose source is the same HTML page(the same is happening with a single iFrame though).
When each iFrame is loaded, the header is correctly set
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111285458-7478c480-8641-11eb-8799-fe9cce49690f.png)

Indeed if i check on the property window.originAgentCluster is always set to **true** for each iframe
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111286520-945cb800-8642-11eb-8c2f-d5bd389a2684.png)

So I would expect each frame to be executed in an isolated thread as I've seen in the [demos](https://origin-isolation-test.com/)
The following is what happens when I try to inspect the dom of an isolated iframe in the demo and the explicit declaration of a separated thread
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111287005-151bb400-8643-11eb-932e-48ec518cc995.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111287073-282e8400-8643-11eb-8652-d3b3d0037dad.png)

Despite everything seems to be correctly set, the iframes I use are not correctly isolated
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22589546/111288480-81e37e00-8644-11eb-9232-76f0bb7566c8.png)

The only difference I can see is the usage of subdomains, but the specs do not seem to mention it as a limit.

I also tried to apply Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy and Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy headers, with no results.

Could you please help me understand where am I doing any kind of mistake or what I did not understood?

Thank you in advance
Matteo
